cards.name: Queen Marabunta
cards.text: Roar: gain 4 food for each other Colony animal you control.

cards.name: Vesper
cards.text: Flight. Has +2 strength for each other Colony animal you control.

cards.name: Queen Honoria
cards.text: Whenever you play a Colony animal, gain 4 food.

cards.name: Falstaff
cards.text: Flight. Whenever you gain food, gain 3 additional food.

cards.name: Nurse Bee
cards.text: Flight. Roar: if you control two of the same Colony animal, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Nurse Bumblebee
cards.text: Flight. Roar: if you control 4 or more Colony animals, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Termite King
cards.text: Roar: if you control a Colony Queen, draw a card.

cards.name: Termite Queen
cards.text: Roar: you may play another non-Queen Colony animal.

cards.name: Guard Wasp
cards.text: Flight. Has +5 strength while you control 4 or more Colony animals.

cards.name: Soldier Ant
cards.text: Roar: if you control 4 or more Colony animals, remove an adjacent enemy.

cards.name: Worker Wasp
cards.text: Flight. At the end of your turn, gain 3 food.

cards.name: Worker Bee
cards.text: Flight. Roar: gain 10 food; if you control another Worker, gain 10 more.
